notes.title: ChangeLog-2.0
notes.content:
【重大更新公告】🌟《国战：春秋》UI全面焕新登场！🎉

亲爱的玩家们，

我们激动地宣布，《国战：春秋》已迎来一场视觉盛宴的革新！🎨 游戏主界面、紧张刺激的战场界面，以及深度策略的政治、经济、外交、政策界面，现已全面换上全新设计的UI界面，旨在为您带来前所未有的游戏体验！🚀

立即下载更新，率先探索这焕然一新的国战世界，感受每一处细节的精雕细琢，让您的春秋霸业之旅更加沉浸与畅快！🌐

不仅如此，我们深知美景配英雄，因此地形美化工作也正在紧锣密鼓地进行中，力求为您呈现一个既真实又梦幻的古代战场。🏞️ 请持续关注我们的进步，更多惊喜即将揭晓！

notes.title: The ancient edition of the War of Nations: Spring and Autumn | will continue to
notes.content:
Dear players, hello!

Since its glorious release in 2021, "War of Nations: Spring and Autumn" has gathered more than 100,000 brave Warring States heroes, and there are still more than 50 passionate players active in this long river of history, this undying enthusiasm makes us deeply gratified and encouraged. In view of the profound heritage of this game and the infinite potential that continues to show, we solemnly decided to carry out a more long-term and firm maintenance and update of "War of Nations: Spring and Autumn".

In order to maintain the content and quality of the game, we had to make a difficult but necessary decision to switch the game from a free-to-play model to a paid model. This change will serve as a powerful source of motivation for us to continue to invest and make unremitting innovations to bring more wonderful game experiences to players.

We sincerely invite every player who loves "War of Nations: Spring and Autumn" to continue to walk with us, witness and enjoy the surprises and changes brought by every update. Please continue to pay attention to our dynamics, let us join hands to open a more brilliant journey of Warring States!

Thank you for your understanding and support, and look forward to writing a new chapter of "National War: Spring and Autumn" with you in the future!

[b] While inviting you to continue to pay attention to "War of Nations: Spring and Autumn", we are also very proud to recommend to you our other two strategy games. These two games also combine deep strategy elements with unique gameplay, which will bring you a new game experience. [/b]
